notes.title: Update 1.3 Is Now Available + Serbian Language
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33634139/6a95ed2c7fc2cf2f0d0ffac267aaca53ad8a48d8.png[/img]

Hi everyone, [b]Dymchick1[/b] is here!

Thank you [b]@Caelliox[/b] for your Serbian
Unfortunately, there is no option to change the language to Serbian in Steam. To change game language to Serbian, open the console (`) and input "ls set ser"

Update 1.3 is now live. 
[b]• Added new time point (check point) after you complete leverage section[/b]
[b]• Added new hidden achievement "Hi, Time Traveler"[/b]
[b]• Added effects in the caves near souls[/b]
[b]• Increased spike's trap delay and increased the size of wooden platforms (it's easier to pass now)[/b]
[b]• Added missing localization[/b] (and improved)

If you find a bug or have suggestions or want to help with translation, join with discord server.
[url=https://discord.gg/cKjPkpe][b]MOMO.EXE DISCORD SERVER[/b][/url]

Enjoy the game!
